title: Synthesis, Cytotoxic Evaluation, and Structure-Activity Relationship of Substituted Quinazolinones as Cyclin-Dependent Kinase 9 Inhibitors.
authors: Alkahtani, Hamad M; Zen, Amer Alhaj; Obaidullah, Ahmad J; Alanazi, Mohammed M; Almehizia, Abdulrahman A; Ansari, Siddique Akber; Aleanizy, Fadilah Sfouq; Alqahtani, Fulwah Yahya; Aldossari, Rana M; Algamdi, Raghad Abdullah; Al-Rasheed, Lamees S; Abdel-Hamided, Sami G; Abdel-Aziz, Alaa A-M; El-Azab, Adel S
one_liner_zh: 该文研究取代喹唑啉酮类CDK9抑制剂合成与构效关系，分子对接仅针对蛋白-小分子，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Cyclin-dependent kinase 9 (CDK9) plays a critical role in transcriptional elongation, through which short-lived antiapoptotic proteins are overexpressed and make cancer cells resistant to apoptosis. Therefore, CDK9 inhibition depletes antiapoptotic proteins, which in turn leads to the reinstatement of apoptosis in cancer cells. Twenty-seven compounds were synthesized, and their CDK9 inhibitory and cytotoxic activities were evaluated. Compounds 7, 9, and 25 were the most potent CDK9 inhibitors, with IC(50) values of 0.115, 0.131, and 0.142 muM, respectively. The binding modes of these molecules were studied via molecular docking, which shows that they occupy the adenosine triphosphate binding site of CDK9. Of these three molecules, compound 25 shows good drug-like properties, as it does not violate Lipinski's rule of five. In addition, this molecule shows promising ligand and lipophilic efficiency values and is an ideal candidate for further optimization.
abstract_zh: 细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶9（CDK9）在转录延伸中发挥关键作用，通过这一过程，短寿命的抗凋亡蛋白过度表达，使癌细胞对凋亡产生抵抗。因此，抑制CDK9会耗竭抗凋亡蛋白，进而导致癌细胞凋亡的恢复。合成了27种化合物，并评估了它们的CDK9抑制活性和细胞毒性活性。化合物7、9和25是最有效的CDK9抑制剂，其IC(50)值分别为0.115、0.131和0.142微摩尔。通过分子对接研究了这些分子的结合模式，表明它们占据了CDK9的三磷酸腺苷结合位点。在这三种分子中，化合物25表现出良好的药物样特性，因为它不违反Lipinski的五规则。此外，该分子显示出有前景的配体效率和亲脂性效率值，是进一步优化的理想候选物。
